claim: With client affinity Source IP, Global Accelerator uses the 2-tuple (source IP and destination IP) to select the hash value and routes a user to the same endpoint whenever they connect. This is not guaranteed in every case: if network maintenance or disruptions shift client traffic to a different edge location that prefers a different AWS Region, client affinity is not guaranteed to be maintained.

evidence.quote: When you specify this option, Global Accelerator uses the 2-tuple properties—source IP and destination IP—to select the hash value and route the user to the same endpoint whenever they connect.
If you want to maintain client affinity by routing a specific user—identified by their source IP address—to the same endpoint each time they connect, set client affinity to **Source IP**.
On occasion, network maintenance or disruptions created by variations in internet traffic routing can cause client traffic to shift to different Global Accelerator edge locations.
When this happens, if the edge location that now serves the client traffic prefers a different AWS Region, then client affinity is not guaranteed to be maintained.
